1) The Company had allotted 20,00,000 warrants on January 30, 2025 and 11,20,000 warrants on February 07, 2025 to 6 allottees belonging to Promoter and Non- Promoter Group on Preferential Basis.

2) The Members of the Company approved the Sub-division/ Split of 1 (One) equity share of face value of Rs.10/- each fully paid-up, into 1 (One) equity shares of face value of Rs.1/- each fully paid-up and the relevant ISIN- INE916Y01019 had also been changed to ISIN - INE916Y01027 in the records of NSDL and CDSL and relevant confirmations were also received from BSE and NSE. Post Sub- division/Split the face value of each equity share of the Company is changed from Rs.10/- to Rs.1/-each fully paid-up w.e.f. April 18, 2025 (Record Date). Accordingly, the number of equity shares increased from 4,26,74,996 to 42,67,49,960 effective from Record Date.

3) The Company had allotted 7,50,00,000 warrants on May 21, 2026 and 4,75,00,000 June 01, 2026 to 15 allottees belonging to Promoter and Non- Promoter Group on Preferential Basis.

4) The Company has allotted 1,30,00,000 and 82,00,000 equity shares pursuant to the conversion of warrants at its meetings held on June 29, 2026 and July 29, 2026 respectively. These shares will be reflected in the beneficiary position (Benpos) upon receipt of the listing and trading approvals from NSE and BSE.

5) The Company forfeited 20,00,000 (Twenty Lakh) Warrants on account of non-payment of 75% of the balance consideration by the respective warrant holders, comprising 10,00,000 Warrants held by shareholders with a nominal value of up to Rs. 2,00,000 and 10,00,000 Warrants held by shareholders with a nominal value of more than Rs. 2,00,000.
